Name: Additional Vanilla Child Beds
Author: fireredlily
Description:
[size=3]Tired of decorating your house only to be stuck with the default child bed? Now you can match your children's beds to the style of your rooms with kid-friendly versions of the many double beds available to the farmer. These are [u]not[/u] visual reskins of the existing default child bed.

This mod adds the following [u]16[/u] beds as new furniture items:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Birch Child Bed (available at the Desert Trader)[/size]
[*][size=3]Deluxe Red Child Bed (available at Robin's shop after Deluxe Red Bed is unlocked)[/size]
[*][size=3]Exotic Child Bed (available at the Qi Gem shop)[/size]
[*][size=3]Fisher Child Bed (available at Willy's shop)[/size]
[*][size=3]Joja Child Bed (only from Joja catalogue!)[/size]
[*][size=3]Junimo Child Bed  (only from Junimo catalogue!)[/size]
[*][size=3]Modern Child Bed (available at the Casino)[/size]
[*][size=3]Midnight Beach Child Bed (available at the Desert Trader)[/size]
[*][size=3]Pinstripe Child Bed (available at Robin's shop after Blue Pinstripe Bed is unlocked)[/size]
[*][size=3]Pirate Child Bed[/size]
[*][size=3]Retro Child Bed  (only from Retro catalogue!)[/size]
[*][size=3]Starry Child Bed[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Strawberry Child Bed[/size]
[*][size=3]Tropical Child Bed (available at the Island Trader)[/size]
[*][size=3]Wild Child Bed (available at the Island Trader)[/size]
[*][size=3]Wizard Child Bed (only from Wizard's catalogue!)[/size]
[/list][size=3]
With the exception of the beds listed as only being obtained from a specific catalogue, all of the beds can also be found randomly in the shop stock lists or in the Furniture Catalogue.[/size]

[b][size=4]Multiplayer Compatibility:[/size]
[/b]All players must have this mod installed to play together, as it adds new furniture objects to the game.

Downloads.Description: This mod adds 16 child beds as custom furniture items, to match the vanilla bed styles available in Stardew Valley. v1.1 adds a config option to add all beds to the Furniture Catalog and fixes the shop listing order in Willy's shop.

Manifest.Description: Adds new furniture items for functional child beds that match the vanilla bed styles.
